GET - Method to retrieve data from a server. Eg: get product information.
POST - Method to add new data to a server. Eg: adding a new product.

PUT - Method to replace/update data on a server, any fields not included in the request body will be deleted and and new fields will be added. Eg: to update the price of an product and remove the color field fromthe product.
PATCH - Method to update data which doesn't affect the other fields, Eg: to update a price of a product but not the name.
DELETE - Method to remove data from a server. Eg: to remove a product.
Uses XML to transfer structured messages between the client and server.
